messages:
ana: kicking off a config-only change during the 02:00-03:00 UTC window. goal: tighten routing floors and reduce batch latency. canary=2% targeted to low-traffic tenants.
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy_id=deploy-2801234567, mode=config-only, canary=2%, target=prod
pat: ack from oncall. will monitor SLOs and tracing.
nana: (typo) sorry, ANA: diff below:
```yaml
routing:
  min_route_weight_percent: 5
  policy: latency-priority
batching:
  max_batch_tokens: 2048
  max_batch_size: 40
  window_ms: 9
timeouts:
  head_ms: 1000
  stream_idle_ms: 25000
```
rene: why 25s stream idle? we have some long-lived streams for partner tenants. suggest leaving stream_idle_ms at 30s for canary only.
nana: good catch. launching canary with routing + batching changes but keeping stream_idle_ms=30000 for the tweak variant.
deploy-bot: canary live: tweak-variant receives 2% traffic (targeted).
obs-bot: canary metrics (6m): p50=39ms, p95=142ms, p99=290ms, errors=0.00%
pat: small tail blip on partner-x traces but no 5xx. looks like reduced batching window lowered latency spikes.
rene: partner-x had reconnects earlier; leaving stream_idle helped. agree to proceed with cautious ramp to 20% over 15m.
nana: ramping now. documented rollback command in ticket: `/deploy rollback deploy-2801234567` and config hash cfg-b7d2.
obs-bot: ramp to 20% after 18m: p95 steady, p99 down ~30ms baseline. no error increase.
pat: adding temporary pin: pin config cfg-b7d2 to variant v13 for 12h to observe.
nana: release notes draft: "Config-only: routing.min_route_weight_percent 0->5, batching.max_batch_size 64->40, batching.window_ms ~12->9. Kept stream_idle_ms at 30s for canary due to streaming tenants. Change window closed 02:28 UTC."
rene: rollback triggers agreed: tenant 5xx > 0.3% OR sustained p99 delta >+180ms for 4m. pat owns rollback.
pat: noted and will escalate if thresholds hit. closing thread unless alerts fire. :white_check_mark:
